description: This file contains unit tests for the CustomersController class using Spring's MockMvc framework, testing endpoints for listing, creating, and deleting customers.

classes.name: test_CustomersControllerWebMvcTest
classes.description: A test class for the CustomersController, verifying web endpoints behavior without running the full application context.

methods.name: list_returnsArrayOfCustomers
methods.description: Tests that the GET /api/customers endpoint returns a list with correct customer data.

methods.name: create_whenValid_returns201AndBody
methods.description: Tests that the POST /api/customers endpoint successfully creates a customer and returns the created object.

methods.name: create_whenMissingRequiredFields_returns400
methods.description: Tests that the POST request with missing data returns a 400 Bad Request.

methods.name: delete_returns204
methods.description: Tests that DELETE /api/customers/123 returns a 204 No Content status.
